### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We must act now—before development crosses a threshold we cannot safely reverse.

2. We refuse to treat superintelligent AI as just another technology. If it is built within 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands. Enforceable safeguards and limits are urgently needed.

3. We know what is at stake: superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. Waiting for tragedy is not responsible policy. Prevention must begin now.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 111 words

We are sounding the alarm because the stakes could not be higher. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. This is not a distant or abstract concern. A system more capable than any human could give bad actors unprecedented power to disrupt critical infrastructure, weaponize science, and inflict harm at enormous scale. We refuse to wait until tragedy proves the danger. We need firm safeguards, enforceable limits, and genuine public accountability before development crosses this threshold. The choices made now will determine whether powerful technology serves humanity or becomes the instrument of a preventable catastrophe.
